defensiveAbilities.name: No Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: A mi-go doesn't breathe and is immune to effects that require breathing (such as an inhaled poison).

offensiveAbilities.name: Clever Disguises
offensiveAbilities.description: A mi-go can use Deception to Impersonate any Medium humanoid creature, although creating such a disguise takes 1 hour. It can't impersonate a specific individual with this ability.

offensiveAbilities.name: Eviscerate
offensiveAbilities.description:
The mi-go performs a swift and painful surgery on a creature it has Grabbed or Restrained or that is otherwise Immobilized, attempting a medicine|defense:fortitude check against the target's Fortitude DC. Regardless of the result, the target then becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

Critical Success The target takes 6d6 Slashing Damage damage, is Slowed 1 for 1 round, and becomes Clumsy 1, Enfeebled 1, or Stupefied 1 (the mi-go chooses) for 24 hours.

Success The target takes 4d6 Slashing Damage damage and is slowed 1 for 1 round by the pain.

Failure The target takes 2d6 Slashing Damage damage.

Critical Failure The target takes no damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A mi-go deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
